name: field
title: Field
description: Responsive form layout around shared controls, with their existing labels, descriptions and validation intact. Group columns follow their container; fieldsets provide legends and inherited disabled state.
example:
<FieldSet legend="Profile" description="Visible to your workspace.">
  <FieldGroup>
    <Field orientation="responsive">
      <Input label="Name" name="name" isRequired />
    </Field>
    <Field orientation="responsive">
      <Select label="Visibility" options={visibilityOptions} />
    </Field>
  </FieldGroup>
</FieldSet>
